integrity.verification: two reproducible Python 3 programs and captured outputs

scientific_limitations: The exact product law applies to connected finite simple cacti with precisely one cycle of length divisible by three. For zero such cycles only the vanishing assertion is established. No claim is made for two or more resonant cycles.
The population is of immediate primitive period-three configurations, not all eventually periodic states or attraction basins.
Finite verification is supporting evidence rather than an all-parameter certificate. Historical priority is subject to coverage limitations.
title: A block-product law for primitive three-periodic excitation on singly resonant cacti
